主要内容: NICHOLAS FINANCIAL INC filed a Form 8-K on April 8, 2014, to disclose that it received notice from Nasdaq on April 3, 2014, that delisting proceedings would commence due to its failure to hold an annual shareholder meeting within the required timeframe under Nasdaq Listing Rules 5620(a) and 5620(b). The company agreed to sell all its issued and outstanding Common Shares to an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Prospect Capital Corporation under a plan of arrangement, with the transaction expected to be completed by June 12, 2014, subject to shareholder approval and satisfaction of conditions. The pending transaction delayed the company's annual meeting. The company also announced plans to mail a proxy statement and related materials to shareholders on or about June 30, 2014, in preparation for its annual general meeting on July 30, 2014, with a record date of June 24, 2014. Prospect filed a Registration Statement on Form N-14 with the SEC, including a Proxy Statement and Prospectus. Investors are urged to review these documents carefully. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Prospect (PSEC).
